summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release on ex vivo mucoadhesion results for an intranasal formulation of MEAI, a psychedelic-based neuroplastogen. The filing reports enhanced nasal retention compared to a standard solution, supporting its development program for Alcohol Use Disorder. No financial terms, transactions, or special situation event are disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report of research progress by a clinical-stage biotech company. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. As a foreign private issuer ordinary progress update, this does not constitute a special situation.
